stories.title: 23 Million User Records Compromised in Gyazo Data Breach
stories.description: Gyazo maker Helpfeel said the attacker exploited a vulnerability in its image upload server to gain unauthorized access.

stories.title: Chrome 153 Patches 16 Security Vulnerabilities Including Critical Dawn and WebGL Flaws
stories.description: Chrome 153 fixes 16 vulnerabilities across Windows, macOS, and Linux, including two critical Dawn and WebGL flaws.

stories.title: Microsoft Patches 18 Vulnerabilities in AI, Cloud Products
stories.description: Microsoft fixed vulnerabilities across Azure and AI-branded products, with privilege escalation flaws accounting for the majority.

stories.title: Android Apps Can Now Check If Your Phone Is Missing Critical Security Patches
stories.description: Android’s new Security State libraries let apps check for missing patches, unpatched components, pending updates, and specific vulnerability fixes.

stories.title: WeaselBiscuit Stealer Spreads via 13 npm Packages to Harvest Chrome Extension Storage
stories.description: Thirteen npm packages deliver WeaselBiscuit, a JavaScript stealer that harvests Chrome extension storage across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

stories.title: NightmareStresser DDoS Service Disrupted in International Operation
stories.description: Active since at least 2022, NightmareStresser was one of the longest-running DDoS-for-hire services in the world.

stories.title: MikroTrick Attack Lets Hackers Gain Full Admin Control of MikroTik Routers Without Login
stories.description: MikroTik routers face a takeover risk as MikroTrick exploits exposed RouterOS SSH flaws to gain admin access without a password.

stories.title: Hackers Use Fake T-Mobile Rewards Expiry Texts to Lure Users to Phishing Sites
stories.description: T-Mobile-themed phishing texts falsely claim expiring rewards, directing victims to fake pages to steal login, payment and personal data.

stories.title: Brevo Supply Chain Attack Injects Malware Into 100,000 Websites
stories.description: Hackers used a compromised API key to deploy a Cloudflare worker that injected malicious scripts.

stories.title: Claimed Bug Bounty Hunter Likely Used LLM to Build PhantomRaven npm Stealer
stories.description: CrowdStrike says PhantomRaven was likely LLM-generated and spread through malicious npm packages that collect developer credentials and CI/CD secrets.

stories.title: RatHat Android Malware Abuses ADB to Retain Shell Access After Uninstall
stories.description: RatHat Android malware abuses Accessibility and ADB pairing to gain shell access and retain control after uninstall.
